# COPS Portal

> The COPS Portal is the U.S. Department of Justice's central hub for law enforcement agencies to request assistance, submit inquiries, and access collaborative reform initiatives.

The portal serves as an intake and inquiry system for the Collaborative Reform Initiative (CRI-TAC) and other COPS programs, enabling law enforcement agencies to connect with DOJ resources and technical assistance. It streamlines the process for agencies to report jurisdictional information and request program support.

## Key Topics

- Collaborative Reform Initiative (CRI)
- CRI-TAC
- COPS (Community Oriented Policing Services)
- U.S. Department of Justice
- Law Enforcement Assistance
- Technical Assistance
- Organizational Assessment
- Critical Response
- Agency Intake
- Assistance Request Forms
- Program Inquiry
- Jurisdiction Information

## Assistance Requests & Inquiries

- [Collaborative Reform Initiative Assistance Request Inquiry](https://portal.cops.usdoj.gov/critac/): CRI-TAC assistance request inquiry portal for law enforcement agencies to submit assistance requests and program inquiries
